Bill.BriefDescription: Restricting the use of personal credit histories and credit scores.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to restricting the use of personal credit historiesand credit scores; adding a new section to chapter 48.18 RCW; andrepealing RCW 48.18.545 and 48.19.035.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 48.18 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The use of a person's credit history or credit score as a factor inunderwriting, renewal, cancellation, and premium decisions by insurersfor personal insurance is prohibited in this state.

The following acts or parts of acts are eachrepealed: RCW 48.18.545 (Underwriting restrictions that apply to personalinsuranceCredit history or insurance scoreRules) and 2002 c 360 s1; and RCW 48.19.035 (Making of ratesDefinitionsPersonalinsuranceUse of credit history or insurance scoresRules) and 2004 p. 1 HB 1927c 86 s 1 & 2002 c 360 s 2.
